name: express-microservices-backend

scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:generate -w @scale/user-service && npm run prisma:generate -w @scale/course-service && npm run prisma:generate -w @scale/job-service && npm run prisma:generate -w @scale/contest-service && npm run prisma:generate -w @scale/community-service
scripts.db:push: npm run db:push -w @scale/user-service && npm run db:push -w @scale/course-service && npm run db:push -w @scale/job-service && npm run db:push -w @scale/contest-service && npm run db:push -w @scale/community-service
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,users,courses,jobs,contests,communities "npm run dev -w @scale/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @scale/user-service" "npm run dev -w @scale/course-service" "npm run dev -w @scale/job-service" "npm run dev -w @scale/contest-service" "npm run dev -w @scale/community-service"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n gateway,users,courses,jobs,contests,communities "npm run start -w @scale/api-gateway" "npm run start -w @scale/user-service" "npm run start -w @scale/course-service" "npm run start -w @scale/job-service" "npm run start -w @scale/contest-service" "npm run start -w @scale/community-service"
scripts.setup:supabase: node scripts/setup-supabase.mjs && npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:push

description: Plain JavaScript Express microservices backend with Prisma and Supabase
